Introduction
This document outlines the equipment 
 inspection list I1, which must be performed every one year as indicated by 
 (Y1) in the above title block.
This pump is used to sodium hypochlorite injection from the sodium 
 hypochlorite storage tank to the intake.
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Mageed Elhenawy, tested at 
 September 2008 , revised by MDEPCo. Quality control Eng. Magdy Hegazy, 
 accepted by eng . Magdy Okba, and approved by eng . Ahmed Abdel Mageed Sowan 
 Nubaria head sector
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel 
 Gilil; MEPC inspection & quality control general Manager& MPIS coordinator, 
 and certified by Eng Mohamed Nageeb inspection & quality control's head 
 sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes breathing mask ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor
Isolate the pump mechanically by 
 closing delivery and suction valves
Be sure pump must be completely 
 drainage
Tools 
and Equipment
Supports and thicknesses
Parallel v block
Hexagonal socket or elbowed wrenchs 
 (16,23,30mm)
Wrenches (8,13,17and 19 mm)
Puller for pins 3,4,6,8mm
Bearing extractor
Pair of levers
Monkey wrench
Hammer
Rubber hummer
Twist drill 3,4,6,8mm
Vernier slide gauge
Emery cloth
Surface gauge.
Work to be 
carried out
Pump in 
 operation
Check pump capacity, pressure and power
Check the Noisy of the Pump.
Check pump and piping for leaks
Pump out of operation
Adjust the pump and piping for leaks
Adjust the fixation
Starting the Pump
Before starting the pump, the following steps should be checked
Open suction and delivery valve .
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting it is clockwise
The level of liquid in the tank must be above the minimum 
 level
The on off valve in the suction from the tank ,must be 
 completely open, while the air discharge valve after complete priming if 
 applicable-and the draining valve must be closed.
The control valve in delivery to the pump , must be 
 partially-but never completely closed
Attendance and checking during 
operation of the pump the following should be checked
Check of flow rate , delivery head and absorbed power.
Check any leakage of pump
